name: Payment Gateway 500 Crash (Primary Demo)
description: Simulate external Payment API returning HTTP 500 internal server error. Observe downstream blast radius affecting Payment Service, Order Service, and Checkout Flow.

name: Geospatial Maps API Gateway Timeout
description: Third-party Maps API experiences socket timeouts (>30s). Location Service degrades, impacting order map tracking and geocoding.

name: Acquirer Rate-Limit Spike (HTTP 429)
description: Payment API rate limits exceed allowed requests per second, returning HTTP 429. Payment Service chokes without client token throttling.

name: Maps API Breaking Schema Drift
description: Maps API releases unannounced breaking change to lat/lng payload format. Location Service throws deserialization errors.

name: Primary Database Latency Degradation
description: Database queries experience heavy lock contention with 6000ms latency spikes, affecting authentication and order creation.
